hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y (positive static gain).
Step response has short delay/lag of 1-5 s before level visibly rises.
There is negligible dead-zone; even small u > 0.1 produces rise relative to u=0.
At u=0 the level decays on its own toward low values with time constant of order tens of seconds.
Gain is approximately linear across u in [0,1] with no strong saturation below 0.85.
Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.6 target is in mid-range ~0.3-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (+/-0.02) relative to control band width 0.10.

Change is weaker actuator: same u gives smaller rise rate and lower held level with similar short lag.

Change is slower response: longer delay ~8-15+s before trend changes and slower approach, causing flat holds then delayed rise/fall and oscillation under old controller.
Change is sensor offset or noise change: different bias or larger variance rather than dynamics change.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Delay before u=0 fall begins and post-delay drain rate, which separates pure long delay from loss of drain and sets integral detuning and feedforward needed to hold 0.6 without oscillation.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case with no drainage or lag is current y 0.5879 + 0.10*0.0*20.0 = 0.5879, well below soft limit 0.85 with large margin; u=0 can only fall.
proposal.expected_observation: If C3 slower-response is right, y will hold near 0.58-0.60 flat within +/-0.02 for the first ~5-10 s after step to 0, then begin falling at ~0.015-0.03/s to ~0.35-0.50 by 20 s with noise +/-0.015, staying above 0.30. Prompt fall within 1-3 s would falsify C3 and favor residual drain dynamics; continued flat with no fall for full 20 s would imply delay >30 s total including E15 or much slower approach.
proposal.readiness_justification: Rise delay and intact gain are resolved by E13-E14, and C1/C2/C4 are largely falsified, but fall delay is not yet bounded because E15 held flat for 15 s with no fall, so one long u=0 hold from a settled high level is needed to measure fall onset and drain rate for delay-robust control.
proposal.operator_note: Holding pump off for 20 s from ~0.59 to measure when the delayed drain begins.
